notes: Fiscal year ended September 1, 2024 (Costco's fiscal 2024; matches data.js fy 'Sep 2024'). Financial figures are from the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000909832-24-000049) and match SEC XBRL. Ownership is from the proxy for the January 2025 annual meeting (DEF 14A filed December 11, 2024, accession 0000909832-24-000072), the first proxy after that fiscal year. LEADER: James Sinegal, co-founder and former CEO, is not a director or named executive officer and does not appear in either ownership table (5% holders, or directors and officers), so his holding, if any, is not reported. HOLDERS: both 5% rows are based on Form 13F-HR filings made November 13, 2024; the proxy gives only the filing date, so asOf is null. The percentages use 443,960,469 shares outstanding on November 15, 2024. DIVIDENDS: cash paid of $9,041 million includes a special dividend of $15 per share; the 10-K says 'Dividends in 2024 included a special dividend of $15 per share, resulting in a payment of approximately $6,655.' Dividends declared in fiscal 2024 were $8,589 million; the record uses cash paid. No dividends to noncontrolling interests were paid in fiscal 2024. BUYBACKS exclude $315 million of tax withholdings on stock-based awards. PLAN: the 10-K mentions an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) only as a line in the income-tax rate reconciliation and describes no employee stock purchase plan, so plan is null.
